name: Minor Power Tier List
subject: minor-powers
methodology: Transcribed from the three-part Minor Power Tier List by Spirit Island Archive, from yt-dlp auto-generated captions (scripts/fetch-transcripts.mjs, scripts/extract-card-tiers.mjs). Each part announces the band it covers: Part 1 (DdZFT5myaDI) S and A tier, Part 2 (bjd98MBYA5U) B tier, Part 3 (-uT5_RQTolE) C and F tier. A card is rated here ONLY where the captions name it verbatim inside a part that covers exactly one band, so the band comes from the video's own declaration rather than from proximity to a spoken tier letter - the reviewer back-references other bands constantly mid-section, which makes proximity unreliable. This list is therefore visibly partial: Part 2 (B tier) is the only single-band part, so S, A, C and F are unrated here pending owner adjudication of the near-miss batch in .scratch/card-tier-lists/extraction/near-miss-review.md. An absent card means this list does not record what the source said about it - never that the source rated it poorly. The series has no D band: Part 1 describes its own split as 'an S and a a b tier and then a CNF'. The source draws a blue X over Growth through Sacrifice; that marks the card as removed by errata and is NOT a tier band. It sits in S tier in the video and is among the entries awaiting adjudication.
